title: The join's admission pipeline (one socket from upgrade to joined)
oneLine: A socket's session from upgrade through auth, refusals, eviction, state build and state_sync, keyed on session.id.
topConcern: Second-login eviction skips webSocketClose, so a second tab escapes a No man's land fight (no linger) with bag and stale HP.

title: The owed respawn replayed at a rejoin
oneLine: ps._respawnOwed marks a respawn the phone never heard, to be replayed after the next join's state_sync.
topConcern: Dead code: the join reads the flag off the player state it just rebuilt from scratch, so the replay never fires.

title: The per-character wrong-key lockout
oneLine: _authFails id -> {count, until}: five wrong keys lock an id for 60 s, shared by join and login door.
topConcern: Two copies of the counter disagree (retired old key counts at the join, not at the door); counts never decay.

title: The login door's per-address throttle
oneLine: _acctIp ip -> {count, windowStart}: 20 tries a minute per address at /api/account.

title: One change at a time to a login record (_authSerial)
oneLine: Per-id promise chain serialising every read-modify-write of auth:<id> across gate-opening awaits.
topConcern: Relies on never re-entering for the same id; a future close hook touching auth: would deadlock that id's joins.

title: A character's devices: the device lock and its one-time fill
oneLine: auth.devs/pass/sealed decide open-first, known, pass or refuse for a key from a device; plus a once-ever fill.
topConcern: On a cold worker the login door and restart ignore devicelock:false (flags only warmed for sockets), refusing new devices the switch should admit.

title: Login keys: each key's life and a new character's first key retired
oneLine: auth.keys made/used/taken back, keyidx index, and fresh -> oldGone retirement of a phone-made first key.
topConcern: Wide cross product of pfHash/fresh/oldGone/keys/devs/sealed/pass with five writers and a phone mirror; a wrong-id new key spends another id's lockout.

title: The account check (Turnstile) at a new character's first join
oneLine: Refused 'verify' with site key, the phone's widget, then a join carrying a token verified by an outside fetch.
topConcern: The verify fetch opens the input gate before session.id is set (ghost body, second join per socket); latent while TURNSTILE_SITEKEY is empty.

title: Test mode: the owner's characters without the honesty checks
oneLine: testmode:<pid> record copied to ps._testMode at join, overridden room-wide by the testmode kill switch.
topConcern: _sigReverifyOk reads the stored record, not _testMode(ps), so with testmode:false thrown a test character still skips the bot re-check.

title: The Wheel's arrival with only the monsters near you
oneLine: session.wheelNear plus _wheelWhole/_wheelSeen sets seeded per arrival, cleared leaving the Wheel; mw sends a monster whole once.

title: Which players' looks a near-join phone holds
oneLine: session._looks, _snapSeq and per-player _lookWholeSeq decide when a look goes whole (pl) or as a list entry.

title: Where the server last had you: the reconnect's judge
oneLine: _lastPlaces remembered at a leave, taken once by the next join, with Wheel way-back fields on the player state.
topConcern: Memory only: the first join after a deploy or idle eviction is never judged (documented); split with movement.js across five fields.

title: The coalesced record save: dirty until flushed
oneLine: _regenDirty/_regenSaveAt coalesce pools, HP above 25% and paced taps into one write per 10 s, flushed on close.
topConcern: The second-login eviction drops the dirty state unflushed, so a second tab rolls back up to 10 s of coalesced PvP and monster damage.

title: The record's shape version: migrate on load, stamp on save
oneLine: blob._v and the in-memory _rpgSaveV note drive the append-only migration table; newer saves refused at join.

title: The v2 player_state delta: what this session was last told
oneLine: session.lastPlayerStateSent caches each field last sent so v2 gets changes only; v1 gets the full state.

title: A character restart: snapshot, wipe, then the player leaves
oneLine: Ordered snapshot and deletion of a dozen per-character keys and caches, state dropped before the leave runs.

title: The live flags cache: unloaded, loaded, written through
oneLine: this._liveFlags lazily loaded; every kill switch read synchronously from it; null reads as nothing thrown.
topConcern: /api/account and /api/admin are routed before the only warm-up, so a cold worker reads every kill switch as untouched there.

title: The daily economy record: a paged job across three tables
oneLine: _metricsJob cursor walks rpg, inbox, orders one page a tick slot; day stamp and an hour's back-off.

title: The sticky announcement (MOTD)
oneLine: Stored motd present or absent, broadcast on announce and sent on every join.

title: The hidden settings: placeholders until the record is read
oneLine: _hiddenLoaded/_hiddenTable merged over public placeholders; newer record never written; hidden_off kill switch.
topConcern: Admin view and botflags read hidden_off without loading flags, so a cold worker shows private values as in force (display only).

title: The owner's levers: freeze, kick, restore
oneLine: frozen:<pid> join gate, kick and freeze put-outs, and an offline-only snapshot restore with a parachute.
topConcern: Restore checks only for a socket; a kicked fighter's lingering body saves its old state over the restored blob within 20 s.

title: The daily rollback snapshots and their two rings
oneLine: rpgsnap_at 20 h throttle and daily/parachute rings of 7, taken at join before the record changes.

title: The owner's test kit on a live player: god mode, refills, quest jumps
oneLine: ps._godUntil timed immunity; refills, unlocks and quest-state writes from the admin-key Test panel.
topConcern: A refill while dying clears dead/dying without respawn, so the server keeps them in place while the phone's watchdog puts them in town.

title: Hemi Bro ownership: nonce, verify, a stored link that goes stale
oneLine: session._broNonce handshake, bro_link fresh/stale with a background re-read, ps.bro/broN badge.
topConcern: A background refresh from the old link can land after a fresh verify and write the old wallet's badge back.

title: The character record: a look and a name written once
oneLine: char:<id> first-write-wins; absent means creating now, a missing key means blank; stamped over every join and relay.
topConcern: The stored shape has no version number for a future look migration.

title: One-time captures at the join: absent means not taken in yet
oneLine: goldNuggets typeof, gemsCaptured, gearStashCaptured, empty weapon tracks and absent prog3 gate a one-time client claim.
topConcern: A stored record with empty weaponSkills re-takes the phone's sanitized claim on every join (legacy track, also stats_update-writable).

title: A guard's gear lock carried across a reconnect
oneLine: gearlock:<pid> timestamp restored into ps._gearLockUntil at join; expires by time.
topConcern: Expired gearlock keys are never deleted.
